what: `on_error:` is a step-level list of steps (next to `run:`, never under `with:`; one step written as a map, or text, is refused) that runs once when its step fails, after the step's `retry` attempts are used up. Any step takes one, an `if:` block, a `for_each:` loop and a `run: parallel` block included: there it handles a failure of any step inside. A direct child of `run: parallel` does not run a handler of its own (put it on the block), and a handler step may carry its own `on_error:`.
sees: `${{ error }}` (the failure as redacted text, see error_value), the request's values and the outputs of the steps that ran before; on a loop, the loop variable of the element that failed. In a `transaction: true` flow the transaction is rolled back first and the handler's own writes are kept (error_handler_response).
after: The flow stays failed: the steps after the failed one do not run, and a loop does not go on to its next element. A handler that reaches a respond, redirect or serve_file step answers the request; without one the caller gets the 500 diagnostic naming the failed step (step_failures), and an async or scheduled run is recorded as failed. So a handler can answer, record or notify; it cannot resume the flow. No handler runs for a flow its time limit stopped, and a respond step whose `${{ }}` did not resolve answers `template_unresolved` itself, not through its handler.
yaml_example:
# flows/import-contact.yaml - one outbound call: retried, a 404 handled, a failure recorded
on:
  request:
    method: POST
    path: /api/crm/contacts/:external_id/import
    auth: required
jobs:
  import:
    steps:
      - id: c
        run: api
        retry: 3                        # three attempts in all
        retry_delay: 500ms
        with:
          url: https://api.example.com/v1/contacts/${{ params.external_id }}
          headers: { Authorization: "Bearer ${{ env.CRM_TOKEN }}" }
          handled_statuses: [404]       # a 404 is an answer here; any other 4xx fails the step
        on_error:                       # runs once, after the last attempt failed
          - run: sql
            with:
              query: "INSERT INTO flow_failures (flow, detail) VALUES ('import-contact', :detail)"
              params: { detail: "${{ error }}" }
          - run: respond
            with: { status: 503, json: { error: crm_unavailable } }
      - if: ${{ steps.c.outputs.status }} == 404
        run: respond
        with: { status: 404, json: { error: contact_not_found } }
      - run: sql
        with:
          query: "INSERT INTO contacts (external_id, name, email) VALUES (:ext, :name, :email) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name, email = excluded.email"
          params: { ext: "${{ steps.c.outputs.json.id }}", name: "${{ steps.c.outputs.json.name }}", email: "${{ steps.c.outputs.json.email || '' }}" }
      - run: respond
        with: { status: 200, json: { imported: "${{ steps.c.outputs.json.id }}" } }
